d: The team take to the skies to treat a boy knocked over by a car in the Isle of Wight, before helping a hard-as-nails grandmother with an ankle injury.
The team of paramedics go to the rescue of a lumberjack who has fallen from a great height and gravely injured himself.
The team hurry to the rescue of an elderly couple who have been involved in serious crash on the A66.
Customs teams check passengers travelling through Shannon Airport, a common place of departure for tourists travelling to Ireland, for illegal items.
Two suspicious bags are taken away for a second look after sniffer dogs raise the alarm, plus a look at the precautions that officers take when they have to go off-site for a job.

At Dublin Airport, Bruce Hellar becomes suspicious after an international traveller enters the country with only one small bag, plus customs workers in Cork search for suspicious items on a cargo ship transporting bananas.
Luggage belonging to two young men returning to Dublin from Ibiza tests positive for drugs, while the hunt is on for illegal cigarettes in Ireland's southwest.
